data.pageStyle:
<style>
/* ===== "Sorry — here's what you'll lose" — brand accent #d72585 ===== */

/* Re-point both component accent tokens to the brand pink */
.wn-wrapper    { --wn-primary: #d72585 !important; }   /* "Sorry" underline */
.lbc-container { --lbc-primary: #d72585 !important; }  /* card accents      */

/* Add-on tags -> soft accent pill */
.lbc-addon-tag {
  background: rgba(215, 37, 133, 0.10) !important;
  color: #b51d6f !important;
}

/* ----- Footer buttons: make the mismatched pair consistent ----- */
/* "Go back to my account" = primary retention CTA (filled pink) */
.cancel-subscription-buttons-container .additional-cancel-button {
  background: #d72585 !important;
  background-image: none !important;   /* kills the blue gradient */
  color: #fff !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  transition: background-color .2s ease !important;
}
.cancel-subscription-buttons-container .additional-cancel-button:hover {
  background: #b51d6f !important;
}

/* "Cancel Now" = de-emphasised secondary (outline) */
.cancel-subscription-buttons-container .cancel-subscription-button {
  background: #fff !important;
  color: #d72585 !important;
  border: 1px solid #d72585 !important;
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  transition: background-color .2s ease !important;
}
.cancel-subscription-buttons-container .cancel-subscription-button:hover {
  background: #fdeef6 !important;
}
</style>

props.subtextMessage: Here are the benefits you'll lose

props.addOnDescription: You'll also lose access to your add-ons:

• Access to all plan features
  • Customer support
  • Regular updates
